name: Cloudflare
summary: Web performance, security and developer platform.

flows.title: Add a DNS record
steps: In the Cloudflare dashboard, go to the DNS Records page.
Complete the required fields, which vary by record. For A, AAAA and CNAME records, decide the Proxy status; TTL controls how long the record is valid.

flows.title: Edit or delete a DNS record
steps: In the Cloudflare dashboard, go to the DNS Records page.
To change it, make the changes and select Save.
To delete it, select Delete, then select Delete again to confirm.

flows.title: Purge everything from the cache
steps: In the Cloudflare dashboard, go to the Configuration page. Cloudflare recommends purging single files by URL instead of the whole cache where possible.
Under Purge Cache, select Purge Everything. A warning window appears.
If you agree, select Purge Everything again. Every resource is cleared from the cache in all Cloudflare data centers.
